metric_definitions.process_wall_ns: process launch, input reading, parsing, validation/export, reporting and destruction
metric_definitions.elapsed_ns: uninstrumented harness snapshot parse only; validation/export excluded
metric_definitions.cold_ns: JSON first parse in a fresh process
metric_definitions.warm_median_ns: JSON ten later full parses in the same process
metric_definitions.peak_rss_bytes: whole-process maximum RSS via macOS time -l; unavailable elsewhere
metric_definitions.heap: requested System bytes; instrumented separately from parse timing
metric_definitions.language_analysis: shared process storage; profiler excludes initialization from snapshot phase
